fields.help_en:
The departure and arrival city codes. Separate multiple cities with Chinese commas (，).
If you set this parameter to 0, city restrictions are not enforced. When using this option, ensure that hotel travel standards are passed for all cities.
When `traffic_type` is set to 0/6/21/25, you can pass either a three-letter airport code or a six-digit city code. For other enum values, pass a six-digit city code.
The departure and arrival cities in `city_set` and the city codes in `city_code_set` must have a one-to-one correspondence.

<warning>When `traffic_type` includes flights, flight tickets cannot be booked if the specified city has no airport.></warning>

Business travel city data:
Three-letter airport code data (https://btrip-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/base-data/btrip-flight-city-data.xlsx)
Six-digit city code data (https://btrip-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/base-data/btrip-hotel-city-data.xlsx)
fields.help_zh:
离抵城市code，多个城市请用中文“，”隔开。
传0时，不管控城市。使用时，请注意酒店差标的传参，确保所有城市都有传入差标。
当交通方式 `traffic_type` 传入 0/6/21/25 时，可传机场三字码或城市六位码。其他枚举值请传城市六位码。
离抵城市 `city_set` 和离抵城市code `city_code_set` 必须一对一。

<warning>当交通方式 `traffic_type` 包含飞机时，如果给到的城市无机场，则不可预订机票。></warning>

商旅城市数据：
机场三字码数据 (https://btrip-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/base-data/btrip-flight-city-data.xlsx)；
城市六字码数据 (https://btrip-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/base-data/btrip-hotel-city-data.xlsx)

The train ticket budget.

parameters.help_en:
The car service budget.
Currency unit: CNY, in cents.

Ride-hailing scenarios involve uncontrollable factors that may cause the actual cost to exceed the estimated price.
The passenger changes the destination offline.
Traffic congestion or other unexpected road conditions. 
The driver adds surcharges, such as tolls, highway fees, or waiting fees

用车预算。

司机添加附加费，如过路费、高速费、等待费等
